label: People
notes: spec 2026-09-28-missive-board-and-spies §1: a spy's estimate is rounded out to this, so a range reads 2,800–3,200

label: Goods a month
notes: units of the manor's chief good a month

label: Wealth
notes: the province's tax per person against every province's terciles (Intel.wealth_tier); always given in words

label: Stance
notes: the player realm's stance toward the holder (the pack's diplomacy.csv), always given

label: Town people
notes: a town's own people, reported when the spy's point lies in the town's cell (Ruling 12, 2026-09-28); the town card reads this, never the manor's people

label: Worth a month
notes: gold a month: the manor's tax and the worth of its goods (ManorBars.worth_of) — the MANORS bars' wealth (owner 2026-10-04)

label: Enemy columns nearby
notes: spec 2026-10-07-enemy-ai-and-battle §2: the enemy hosts' columns (GameState.foes) within spy_radius_km; a spy reports it only when there is one

label: Enemy men nearby
notes: the men under arms (headcount less the dead) of those columns

label: Enemy losses
notes: spec 2026-10-07-enemy-ai-and-battle §2/§4.5: the enemy's dead and wounded in a battle round as our men count them (MissiveWriter battle letter), an estimate at battle_foe_estimate_quality rounded out to this
